opensen.name: OpenSen
opensen.tagline: Learn English through chunking — memorize whole phrases, not words.
opensen.description: Open Sentence is a language learning ecosystem that helps learners memorize English through the chunking method: memorizing whole sentences and pre-assembled phrases so they retrieve language automatically rather than constructing it word-by-word.
features: Dialog Builder — Generate memorization-ready dialogs and speeches
Chunk Library — High-frequency native phrases with swap patterns
Situation Coverage — Real-world scenarios (small talk, ordering, travel, etc.)
Practice Plan — Spaced repetition based practice schedules
Anki export — Take your chunks anywhere

yt-hunter.name: YT Hunter
yt-hunter.tagline: Save YouTube URLs and auto-fetch transcripts instantly.
yt-hunter.description: A small open-source tool with a mobile app and browser extension. Paste a YouTube URL and YT Hunter automatically saves the video and fetches the transcript via TranscriptAPI — stored locally with the video reference.
features: Browser extension for Chrome & Firefox — one-click save
Mobile app (Flutter / React Native) for on-the-go capture
Local storage with IndexedDB — your data stays yours
Optional sync backend for multi-device access

open-farm.name: Open Farm
open-farm.tagline: An AI-powered food trust platform on Sui — scan a QR code and see who grew your food, idea by Henry Nguyen.
open-farm.description: Open Farm is an AI-powered agricultural trust platform built on Sui. It helps people who buy food connect directly with the farmers who grow it. Scan a product's QR code and you can instantly see who grew the food, its harvest history, a sustainability score, AI farming insights, and a community trust score. The goal is simple: food should not only be traceable — it should feel human, carrying the identity, trust, and story of the person who grew it. Built by Henry Nguyen and submitted to a hackathon on Devpost.
open-farm.problem: Today, food has a big trust gap. Shoppers rarely know where their food comes from, who produced it, or whether it was grown in a sustainable way. At the same time, farmers find it hard to build a digital reputation, prove their product is good, and reach buyers directly. Climate change makes farming even less predictable each year. Open Farm was built so every harvest can carry identity, trust, and a human story.
features: Farmer Passport — each farmer gets an on-chain identity, a trust score, sustainability badges, and a full harvest history
Harvest Story Timeline — the journey of every crop (planting, watering, harvesting, delivery) is recorded and stored with Walrus decentralized storage
AI Farm Copilot — AI helps farmers with crop disease detection, weather forecasts, irrigation tips, and climate risk alerts
QR Crop Verification — shoppers scan a product to instantly see its farm origin, harvest timeline, the farmer's story, and sustainability insights
Community Reputation System — trust scores are built from delivery consistency, crop quality, sustainable practices, and buyer feedback
Invisible Web3 — zkLogin lets non-crypto users sign in with a normal account, so the blockchain stays out of the way

techStack.label: How it's built
groups: Blockchain — Sui (fast, consumer-grade UX and object-centric design for crop tracking), Walrus (decentralized storage for harvest media), zkLogin (easy onboarding)
AI — OpenAI API, image recognition for crop health, climate analytics
Design — Figma, a cinematic UI approach instead of a plain dashboard
